'''Classes''' are an integral property of adventuring [[cats]], which apply [[stat]] modifiers and determine which abilities are offered from post combat rewards. Newborn cats start out {{Class|Collarless}}, but may become a different class by assigning the corresponding collar (if it is unlocked) when beginning a new adventure. If no collar is assigned, the cat will receive no stat modifiers and will only be offered Collarless abilities which are offered to all cats.

Initially, only five classes are available: {{Class|Collarless}}, {{ClassIcon|Fighter}}, {{ClassIcon|Hunter}}, {{ClassIcon|Mage}}, and {{ClassIcon|Tank}}. Additional classes are unlocked by beating areas for the first time and then talking to {{NPC|Butch}}, who will award that area's corresponding collar.


{{dLC|1|The first DLC will add four additional classes.}}

== Trivia ==
* The [[Minibosses]] for every [[Act|Act's]] first [[Chapter]] are all cats that represent one of the classes. Generally, these minibosses are based on the classes that were unlocked in the previous Act, though there are some exceptions.
** {{mb|Magnus}} represents the {{Class|Fighter}} 
** {{mb|Fenrir}} represents the {{Class|Hunter}} 
** {{mb|Maisie}} represents the {{Class|Tank}} 
** {{mb|Lucy}} represents the {{Class|Mage}} 
** {{mb|Marshmallow}} represents the {{Class|Cleric}} 
** {{mb|Dack}} represents the {{Class|Thief}} 
** {{mb|Morana}} represents the {{Class|Necromancer}} 
** {{mb|Gein}} represents the {{Class|Butcher}} (unlocked by completing {{chapter|Core}} instead of an Act 1 chapter)
** {{mb|Alice}} represents the {{Class|Psychic}} 
** {{mb|Draven}} represents the {{Class|Druid}} 
** {{mb|Franklin}} represents the {{Class|Tinkerer}} 
** {{mb|Chan Hung}} represents the {{Class|Monk}} (unlocked by completing {{ch|The Lab}} instead of an Act 2 chapter)
** {{mb|Arthur}} represents the {{Class|Jester}} (unlocked after completing {{chapter|Rift}}, can appear in any Act)
** {{b|Pebbles}} represents the {{Class|Collarless}} class despite being considered a Boss and not a Mini-Boss.
* {{en|Spun Cat}} has themed variants for every class except for {{cl|Collarless}} and {{cl|Jester}}.
* Most of the classes in ''Mewgenics'' are either directly comparable or strikingly similar to the various classes from ''Dungeons & Dragons''.<ref>[https://www.dndbeyond.com/classes?srsltid=AfmBOoozEmn3R3UZW0EGYs7F91XNC0-rw_TV0fztzM7cdB-Vta_7Y7jA D&D Class list]</ref>
** Direct analogues include:
***{{cl|Fighter}}
***{{cl|Cleric}}
***{{cl|Druid}}
***{{cl|Monk}}
**Different in name, but very similar in function/themeing/playstyle:
*** {{class|Mage}}: Wizard
*** {{class|Hunter}}: Ranger
*** {{class|Thief}}: Rogue
*** {{cl|Necromancer}}: A subclass of Wizard
*** {{class|Tinkerer}}: Artificer
*** {{class|Druid}}: Bard, in addition to Druid
*** {{class|Psychic}}: Mystic
*The {{class|Collarless}} class is a portmanteau of "collar" and "colorless," the latter being a reference to the colorless mana type in ''Magic: The Gathering.''<ref>https://mtg.wiki/page/Colorless</ref>
* [[Tyler]] and [[Edmund]] split the responsibilities of designing the classes, with each taking the lead role and the other taking on a supporting role during the design.<ref name="edmunddesign">[https://youtu.be/SuJIx4ZcZ9E?t=1870 Edmund on sharing the design of the game]</ref> Tyler was the primary designer for {{cl|Tinkerer}}, {{class|Druid}}, {{class|Psychic}}, and {{class|Butcher}}.<ref>[https://x.com/i/status/2026794470164078781 Tyler's Twitter]</ref> While Edmund was the primary designer for {{cl|Necromancer}}.<ref name="edmunddesign" />
